id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f210: "I'm truly sorry. Seeing a Heliodor soldier, whom we've long been at odds with, I lost my head.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f2ec: "So he's a friend of the Luminary. I deeply apologize for my rude behavior.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f3f0: "High Priest Sampo saw at once that you were the Luminary, but I couldn't.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f4bc: "I thought I'd trained my eye for people, but I clearly need more training.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f5b0: "Luminary, I heard. You're going to rescue the trainee who headed to the Summit Sanctuary.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f674: "I'd like to go with you, but I'd only slow you down. I'll wait here.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f770: "This is Angri-La, village of trainees. Welcome, Luminary.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f938: "This is Angri-La, village of trainees. Welcome, Luminary.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f808: "You were meant to train with us, so you're practically family. Think of this as your hometown and rest.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f9d0: "You must be tired from fighting the Dark One. Rest here as long as you like. We'll host you as best we can.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fb24: "Oh, that appearance! You must be Luminary {var:1}! It's a great honor to meet you!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fbd0: "On orders from Master Nima, Angri-La's leader, we awaited your arrival.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fc84: "The Master has something to tell you. Climb the stairs and head to the Grand Training Ground from the palace at the top.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|feac: "Welcome to Angri-La! You're the Luminary we've waited for. High Priest Sampo told me.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ff60: "We've waited for this day all along. Everyone in the village wants to talk to you, so please say hello.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|104a: "We've waited for this day all along. Everyone in the village wants to talk to you, so please say hello.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1006: "The first Master deliberately built Angri-La on a remote sheer cliff.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1013: "It's so monks can stay away from worldly temptation and focus on training. The first Master thought it through.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1026: "Welcome, Luminary! Hearing you beat the Dark One, we were just talking about you.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1031: "Everyone wants to talk to the world's savior, so please say hello.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|103e: "Welcome to Angri-La! You're the Luminary we've waited for. The Master told us you'd come!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|106c: "High Priest Sampo has a gift for seeing people's talent. The Master saw his power and promoted him young.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|107c: "His youth made other monks wary of him at times, but now his virtue makes everyone adore him.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|108d: "Everything that happens in this world has meaning... that was the Master's teaching.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10ac: "Everything that happens in this world has meaning... that was the Master's teaching.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1097: "There must be meaning in the Luminary going to the summit to help a trainee. Do your best at the task before you.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10b6: "There must be meaning in the Luminary going to the summit to help a trainee. Do your best at the task before you.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10cb: "Thanks to the Master the village was safe, but many people in this world still suffer.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10d7: "Your role is to bring hope to such people. I'm counting on you, Luminary.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|114e: "Your role is to bring hope to such people. I'm counting on you, Luminary.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10e4: "The view from the village is wonderful. The Master protected this scenery... now we must protect it.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10f6: "By defeating the Dark One, you revived Yggdrasil, and the wounded world will slowly recover.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1105: "It's all thanks to you. I can't thank you enough...
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|110f: "The view from the village is wonderful. This scenery, full of life's radiance... we must protect it.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|115b: "The view from the village is wonderful. This scenery, full of life's radiance... we must protect it.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1121: "Oh! At last this moment! You are the Prince of Dundrasil and the reborn legendary Luminary...
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|112c: "With the ominous black sun revived, you visit this village now... It can only be that the threads of fate led you.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1140: "I hear monsters have grown violent and are causing harm around the world. Many people must be suffering.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1182: "Since the Luminary came, the grown-ups are gathering at the palace. They say the long-awaited day has finally come.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|118f: "But what's a Luminary? I'll ask Mom later.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|119b: "Everyone's making a fuss, so maybe a Luminary is amazing. But I like the legendary disciple better.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1278: "Everyone's making a fuss, so maybe a Luminary is amazing. But I like the legendary disciple better.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11a7: "The legendary disciple was the Master's first pupil, and had amazing strength. He's my hero.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1284: "The legendary disciple was the Master's first pupil, and had amazing strength. He's my hero.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11b9: "Someone went to the summit alone, and everyone's worried.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11cf: "Someone went to the summit alone, and everyone's worried.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11c0: "Aww, if only the legendary disciple were here, he'd solve everything easily.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11d6: "Aww, if only the legendary disciple were here, he'd solve everything easily.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11e6: "The legendary disciple who trained under the Master long ago is my hero.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1296: "The legendary disciple who trained under the Master long ago is my hero.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11f0: "I imagined someone super cool, but in person he's just a plain, chubby old man. Kind of a shock.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12a0: "I imagined someone super cool, but in person he's just a plain, chubby old man. Kind of a shock.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1201: "It's a shock that my hero is a plain old man, but he's the legendary disciple, so he must be amazing.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12b1: "It's a shock that my hero is a plain old man, but he's the legendary disciple, so he must be amazing.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1211: "I'm going to become High Priest Sampo's disciple. Hard training awaits, so I'm climbing stairs now to build my legs.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1240: "I'm going to become High Priest Sampo's disciple. Hard training awaits, so I'm climbing stairs now to build my legs.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1223: "I'll train hard too, and hope to become like the legendary disciple someday.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12d2: "I'll train hard too, and hope to become like the legendary disciple someday.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|122e: "They say Lord Rab and the Luminary beat the Dark One! He's a plain chubby old man, but he's amazing!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1252: "I'll train hard too, and hope to become like the legendary disciple someday.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|125e: "Since the Luminary came, the grown-ups are gathering at the training ground. The long-awaited day has come, they say.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|126c: "But what's a Luminary? I'll ask Mom later.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12c1: "I'm going to become the Master's disciple. Hard training awaits, so I'm climbing stairs now to build my legs.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12ed: "This man was lying collapsed on Mount Pang Lai. He was badly hurt and in danger of dying, but he's recovered a lot.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12fa: "At first we were wary of him as a Heliodor soldier, but now we know he's not bad, so everyone's kind to him.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|130c: "Oh, your friend is a Heliodor soldier too, so you were suspected? Hehe, what a misfortune.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1316: "But this is no time for people to fight. We must join forces and fight the Dark One.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1328: "This man still seems to believe the Luminary is the Darkspawn. That was common sense in Heliodor.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1334: "Oh, but rest easy. I'll clear up the misunderstanding that the Luminary is a bad person.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1344: "This man believed the Luminary was the Darkspawn, but when I explained otherwise, he finally understood.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1354: "You're the hero of world peace. As one person living in this world, I thank you from the bottom of my heart.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1367: "This man is a Heliodor soldier who was blocking Mount Pang Lai.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|136f: "At first everyone was wary of him, but now we know he's not bad, so they're kind to him.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1391: "Welcome, Luminary. All of Angri-La's people welcome you.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|144f: "Welcome, Luminary. All of Angri-La's people welcome you.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|139a: "There was someone we wanted you to meet when you visited... Please ask the High Priest for details.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13ac: "Had the Luminary trained under the Master, you might have gained incredible power. Enough to beat the Dark One...
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13c7: "Had the Luminary trained under the Master, you might have gained incredible power. Enough to beat the Dark One...
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13ba: "Though it's too late to say that now that Master Nima is gone...
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13d5: "Though it's too late to say that now that Master Nima is gone...
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13e3: "Lord Rab went to the Underworld, the world between life and death, to master the village's secret art.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13ee: "Entering the Underworld at risk of his life and truly mastering the secret art. As expected of the Master's first disciple.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1402: "When Yggdrasil fell, I wondered what would become of the world, but little by little I see hope.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|140e: "After all, you and Lord Rab trained under the Master. Somehow it'll work out.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|141c: "Lord Rab defeated the Dark One Mordegon with you.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1435: "Lord Rab defeated the Dark One Mordegon with you.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1422: "Challenging the Dark One at risk of his life and truly defeating him. As expected of the Master's first disciple.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|143c: "Challenging the Dark One at risk of his life and truly defeating him. As expected of the Master's first disciple.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1457: "But I think the Master welcomes you most of all. For sixteen years she worried about you.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|146a: "I hear the Master's training has begun. It must be tough, since it has to finish in a short time.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|147a: "But I doubt it'll cost you your life, so rest easy... hehe.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1486: "The Master said a monster powerful enough to destroy the world has revived. But there's no need to worry.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1493: "After all, you and Lord Rab, the Master's fine disciples, are here. Somehow it'll work out.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14b2: "Angri-La, village of trainees, has an outrageous training that draws out one's full potential.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14c0: "Before Heliodor blockaded the mountain path, many strong people from around the world gathered for that training.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14d1: "Hey, Luminary, wasn't it delicious? The Angri-La dishes served at the feast. I made all of them myself.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14e0: "Everyone trains even when it's hard, so you do your best too. Don't run away just because it hurts.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14ee: "Mount Pang Lai and Zwaardsrust, called the Sages' Twin Peaks around Yggdrasil, once had villagers visiting each other.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14fe: "Mount Pang Lai escaped Yggdrasil's shock wave thanks to the Master, but how is Zwaardsrust... I'm worried.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1511: "This kid nearly quit the harsh training, but seeing the Luminary risk his life for the secret art revived his drive.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1523: "I'm not asking him to be like the Luminary, but I hope he keeps training and becomes a full-fledged monk.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1534: "Many died because of the Dark One, but now the survivors must restore the world to what it was.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1542: "No matter what happens, rebuilding Erdrea is the survivors' duty.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1552: "The Dark One is gone, but not every monster is. Some of his remnants remain.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|155e: "You should hurry and become a full-fledged monk too, and fight alongside High Priest Sampo and the others.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|156d: "We saw the Luminary's star fall from here too. The village is far, so no effect, but I worry about the people in Gondolia region.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1583: "This kid nearly quit the harsh training, but seeing people attacked by monsters made him keep going.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1593: "He says he'll protect the villagers no matter what. A whiner at first, but he's grown up before I knew it.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15b4: "...Oh, a face I don't know. Could you be the Prince of Dundrasil?
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15bd: "I knew it. You somehow resemble an old friend of mine, especially around the eyes.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15cb: "Oh, is that so? You somehow resemble an old friend of mine, so I was sure you were him.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15dc: "My old friend Rab was a mischievous brat with a runny nose, always scolded by the Master.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15e8: "Even when hit with the spanking stick he never reflected, so the Master had her hands full.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15f5: "Rab had many problems, but he saw through anything he decided on. I didn't dislike him.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1603: "Seeing Rab's face after so long put me at ease. He'd been missing, so I worried.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1612: "You defeated the Dark One? Well done! He was our hated enemy for the Master's death! Truly well done!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1630: "I was attacked by monsters while traveling, and a monk of this village saved me.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|164c: "I was attacked by monsters while traveling, and a monk of this village saved me.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|163a: "Defeating fierce monsters bare-handed. Angri-La's monks are amazing. No wonder, training all the time.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1656: "Many kind people live in this village. It's dangerous outside, so maybe I'll settle down here.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1667: "This man won't look me in the eye when he talks. He's so shy.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1671: "Hehe, I like innocent men not used to women. Maybe I'll tease him a little.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1681: "I was attacked by monsters while traveling and barely escaped to this village.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|168a: "Many kind people live here, so I decided to settle down. Monks protect me in a pinch, too.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|169d: "When I come to this palace, monks keep gathering around. Talking with girls must be really rare for them.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16ab: "But they all talk so happily that it makes me smile too.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16c8: "Angri-La is a village of training where many trainees forge themselves. You came to train too, right?
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16d6: "I thought so. Then train at the Grand Training Ground. A great wizard trained at that famous place.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16e9: "Oh really? You're not a trainee, yet you came to this remote village. You're a strange one.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16f8: "Luminary, you're going to help someone in trouble. How kind. I wish my brother would follow your example.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1708: "Mumble mumble... Brother, don't give up... Do your best in training...
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1743: "Mumble mumble... Brother, don't give up... Do your best in training...
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|177e: "Mumble mumble... Brother, don't give up... Do your best in training...
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17b6: "Mumble mumble... Brother, don't give up... Do your best in training...
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1714: "You rescued Lord Rab, so the Luminary is strong, unlike my brother. Could you train him sometime?
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1724: "Thanks! My brother goes soft if you spoil him, so train him hard!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1760: "Thanks! My brother goes soft if you spoil him, so train him hard!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1798: "Thanks! My brother goes soft if you spoil him, so train him hard!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1731: "I see. You're busy, so it can't be helped... But even the Luminary giving up on him. My brother must have no talent.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|176c: "I see. You're busy, so it can't be helped... But even the Luminary giving up on him. My brother must have no talent.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17a4: "I see. You're busy, so it can't be helped... But even the Luminary giving up on him. My brother must have no talent.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|174f: "You beat the Dark One, so the Luminary is strong, unlike my brother. Could you train him sometime?
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|178a: "You're called a Luminary, so you must be strong. Could you train my brother sometime?
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17d3: "The long-awaited Luminary has finally come! There's no happier day! I have to prepare the feast quickly!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17e4: "The custom of Dundrasil princes training at the Grand Training Ground began from Erdwin of Dundrasil training in this village.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|180a: "The custom of Dundrasil princes training at the Grand Training Ground began from Erdwin of Dundrasil training in this village.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17f6: "The next Luminary visiting here may be the result of the Luminary's fate from ancient times guiding you.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|181b: "The next Luminary visiting here may be the result of the Luminary's fate from ancient times guiding you.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|182f: "Wow, I was amazed! Lord Rab, gaunt and near death, ate porridge and returned to his old self in no time.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|183d: "...That was no human feat. As expected of the legendary disciple.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|184b: "...What? You missed the moment Lord Rab returned to his old self?
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1854: "What a shame! You rarely see such a sight. What a waste.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1862: "The Underworld... I'd heard the legends, but a world between life and death really exists.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|186f: "When I die, will I go there too? ...Ugh, thinking about it scares me.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|187c: "Luminary, I believed you would defeat the Dark One. After all, you're Master Nima's disciple.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|188c: "Luminary, I believed you would defeat the Dark One. After all, you're Master Nima's disciple.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|189d: "Starting training the moment you arrived in Angri-La. You're as diligent as any past prince. As expected of a Luminary.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18b1: "Angri-La legend says creatures who lose their lives become souls and go to the Underworld, between life and death.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18c1: "...What, you've already been to the Underworld! At your age! As expected of a Luminary.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18e5: "Monks gathered in a hurry at this palace. It seems High Priest Sampo ordered it.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18f2: "Even the usually calm monks are panicking. What on earth is about to begin?
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|197d: "Even the usually calm monks are panicking. What on earth is about to begin?
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18ff: "With monsters violent because of the Dark One, he headed to the summit alone. What is he thinking...
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1912: "Master Nima is a highly skilled sage with many disciples worldwide, starting with the Prince of Dundrasil.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|191f: "I came to this village to be trained by the Master, but to find she has died... truly regrettable.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1931: "Please, let me train in this village too. I want to grow stronger and strike back at the monsters.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|198a: "Please, let me train in this village too. I want to grow stronger and strike back at the monsters.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1940: "I hear the Master trained you. She is famous as an excellent sage. I envy you for receiving her teaching.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1952: "...Yes, you're right. From now on I'll do my part in rebuilding the village.

tm.「本当に 申し訳ありません。\n ずっと敵対していた デルカダール兵を見て\n: "I'm truly sorry. Seeing a Heliodor soldier, whom we've long been at odds with, I lost my head.
tm.「勇者さまのご友人だったのですね。\n 失礼な態度を とってしまったこと\n 深: "So he's a friend of the Luminary. I deeply apologize for my rude behavior.
tm.「サンポ大僧正は 即座に\n あなたが勇者であると 見抜きましたが\n 私には: "High Priest Sampo saw at once that you were the Luminary, but I couldn't.
